caption.markdownDescription:

icon-type.markdownDescription:
Icon type defines a source of an item image displayed in inventory.
- **none** - invisible type, used for *core:empty* only (empty item, like the air block). May be removed in future updates.
- **sprite** - default type. 2D image. Requires *icon* set to *atlas_name:texture_name*. Example: *blocks:notfound*.
  There are two atlases available:
	- **blocks** (generated from *png* files in *res/textures/blocks/*)
	- **items** (generated from *png* files in *res/textures/items/*)
- **block** - block preview. Block ID must be specified in **icon** property. Example: *base:wood*.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/item-properties.md#icon-type-and-icon-itself)

model-name.markdownDescription:
Name of the item model. The model will be loaded automatically.
Default value is `packid:itemname.model`.
If the model is not specified, an automatic one will be generated.

Default: `<item id>.model`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/item-properties.md#item-model---model-name)
model-name.description:

Default value is packid:itemname.model.
If the model is not specified, an automatic one will be generated.

Default: <item id>.model.

placing-block.markdownDescription:
Specifies what block will be placed on RMB click. Automatically specified in generated items.

Example: an item that places bazalt blocks:

```json
"placing-block": "base:bazalt"
```

Default: `"core:air"`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/item-properties.md#placing-block)

emission.markdownDescription:
Light emitted when player holds the item in hand.

An array of 3 integers - R, G, B of light in range \[0, 15\]

Examples:

- *\[15, 15, 15\]* - white with maximal intensity
- *\[7, 0, 0\]* - dim red light
- *\[0, 0, 0\]* - no emission (default value)

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/item-properties.md#emission)

uses.markdownDescription:
Property used via [inventory.use](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/scripting/builtins/libinventory.md).

Property status is displayed in the inventory interface. Display method is defined via `uses-display`.

`-1` (default) means the item has no uses counter.

_Not available in `item.properties` (removed by `res/scripts/post_content.lua`)._

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/item-properties.md#number-of-uses-durability---uses)

uses-display.markdownDescription:
- `none` - display disabled
- `number` - number
- `relation` - current value to initial value (x/y)
- `vbar` - vertical scale (used by default)

_Not available in `item.properties` (removed by `res/scripts/post_content.lua`)._

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/item-properties.md#display-of-remaining-uses-count---uses-display)

script-name.markdownDescription:
Defines the name of the script containing the item's event handlers. By default, equals to the item's string id (name).
Allows you to reuse a single script for multiple items.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/item-properties.md#script-name)

tags.markdownDescription:
Tags allow you to designate general properties of items. Names should be formatted as `prefix:tag_name`.
The prefix is optional, but helps avoid unwanted logical collisions. Example:

```json
{
    "tags": [
        "core:fuel",
        "base_survival:poison",
    ]
}
```

Tags can also be added to items from other packs using the `your_pack:tags.toml` file. Example

```toml
"prefix:tag_name" = [
    "random_pack:item",
    "another_pack:some_block",
]
"other_prefix:other_tag_name" = [
    # ...
]
```

_Not available in `item.properties` (removed by `res/scripts/post_content.lua`)._

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/item-properties.md#tags)

emission@append.markdownDescription: Method `@append`: appends the value(s) to the list `emission` of a previous definition of this item (e.g. from another pack) instead of replacing it. It affects the Lua-side `item.properties` table; the engine itself reads `emission` directly.

^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$.description: User property (pack:name). It must be declared in some pack's config/user-props.toml, otherwise it is removed from the Lua properties table.

^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+@.description: Appends to a list-valued user property (method @append).
